source: JZ Mock A · Paper 2 · Question 6 · Publisher worked answer
label: JZ Mock A · Paper 2 · Question 6
knowledgePattern: Bound a three-way overlap using its complement and attain the bound
solution:
A book fails the required description if it is paperback, illustrated, or not in English. There are respectively 60, 70 and 30 books with these properties. Their union contains at most 160 books, because overlaps would count a book more than once in that sum.

Therefore at least 200−160=40 books satisfy all three desired properties.

This bound is attainable: allocate 60 paperbacks that are not illustrated and are English; 70 hardbacks that are illustrated and English; 30 hardbacks that are not illustrated and are not English; and 40 hardbacks that are not illustrated and English. These groups give every stated total.

The minimum is 40. Answer D.
